notes:
关闭 Steam 自带的游戏内覆盖层。请先完全退出 Steam，再打开管理器，然后再开 Steam。之后从游戏内退出，库里的停止按钮会回到开始游戏。Shift+Tab 会关掉，好友叠加不受影响。
Turns off the Steam in-game overlay. Fully quit Steam, open the manager, then start Steam again. Quitting the game then returns the library button from Stop to Play. Shift+Tab is off. The friend-list mod is unaffected.
